mechanism_scan.mechanism: EMD layers share weights and use absolute position embeddings

mechanism_scan.evidence: The $n$ layers can share the same weight.

mechanism_scan.mechanism: 1.5B only: relative position projections shared with content projections
mechanism_scan.where: llm extraction, verified quote, Sec. Scale up to 1.5 billion parameters
mechanism_scan.evidence: First, we share the projection matrices of relative position embedding $W_{k,r},W_{q,r}$ with $W_{k,c},W_{q,c}$, respectively, in all attention layers to reduce the number of model parameters.

mechanism_scan.mechanism: 1.5B only: convolution layer beside the first Transformer layer, outputs summed
mechanism_scan.where: llm extraction, verified quote, Sec. Scale up to 1.5 billion parameters
mechanism_scan.evidence: Second, a convolution layer is added aside the first Transformer layer to induce n-gram knowledge of sub-word encodings and their outputs are summed up before feeding to the next Transformer layer

new_ops.name: disentangled_attention
new_ops.reason: Needs an attention primitive whose scores are Q_c K_c^T + Q_c K_r[delta(i,j)]^T + K_c Q_r[delta(j,i)]^T, scaled by 1/sqrt(3d), where K_r=P W_{k,r}, Q_r=P W_{q,r} are projections of a [2k, d] relative position table P shared across layers, and delta(i,j)=clip(i-j+k, 0, 2k-1); gathers over relative-distance indices per (i,j) pair.

new_ops.name: enhanced_mask_decoder
new_ops.reason: Needs a decoder layer taking two inputs (I as query, H as context) where I is absolute position embedding (plus content) for the first layer, stacked n=2 times with shared weights; absolute position embedding table and the exact internal composition are not given in the IR terms.

output.notes: Described the base DeBERTa model (smallest of the paper's listed sizes; base-ablation config omitted as it's an analysis setting with identical shape). Block ops use base sizes. LayerNorm/post-norm/GELU/biases/tying are inherited from BERT via the base-structure inheritance sentence. Norm eps, GELU approximation, and context length are not stated (k=512 is the max relative distance, not a context length). Vocab: base/large use the GPT-2/RoBERTa BPE vocab without a stated size; 1.5B uses a vocab of '128K', left not_stated because the exact count is not given. 1.5B adds shared projections and a convolution layer (listed outside IR). SiFT is fine-tuning only.
